 105.5 WDHA Author Jean Chatzky On How To Create A “Forever Paycheck”
 Jim Monaghan’s guest this week on Jersey Magazine is New York Times and Wall Street Journal bestselling author Jean Chatzky, author of the new book Forever Paycheck. Saving for retirement…
 Jim Monaghan 
 Published Nov 8, 2026 6:00 AM EST Share this story Jim Monaghan's guest this week on Jersey Magazine is New York Times and Wall Street Journal bestselling author Jean Chatzky , author of the new book Forever Paycheck . 
 Saving for retirement is only half the equation — how to turn those savings into income without running out of money is the challenge many Americans face. 
 As more people here in New Jersey enter retirement without traditional pensions and live longer, bestselling author and AARP Personal Finance Columnist Jean Chatzky has a new strategy for making retirement savings last while reducing the fear of spending them. 
 Get more information at https://aarp.org/foreverpaycheck .
 News Radio Veteran Tim Scheld On His "Front Row Seat"
 Jim Monaghan's guest on Jersey Magazine is news radio veteran Tim Scheld who has just published his first book, My Front Row Seat: A Newsman's Journey . 
 New Jersey listeners will remember Tim as a reporter for ABC as well as the news director and ultimately brand managed for WCBS Newsradio 880 in New York City. 
 Tim's front row seat included covering the Oklahoma City bombing, the Columbine shooting, Super Storm Sandy, 9/11 and so much more. The conversation includes how both the delivery and consumption of news has changed in recent years, as well as the recent banning of multiple news outlets from the White House by President Trump. 
 A longtime Bergen County resident, Tim is also an Adjunct Professor teaching Media Management (undergraduate) and Strategic Communications (graduate) in the College of Communication and Media at Montclair State University.
